### Are You Losing the Battle with Sin?
Author: Jeff Schreve
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/fromhisheart/are-you-losing-the-battle-with-sin-from-his-heart-march-30.html
Passage: 1 John 2:15-16
Points:
- Every Christian deals with temptation and must guard against the pull of the world.
- Succumbing to worldly desires signals a loss of vital connection to the Father's love.
- Obedience to God's commands flows naturally from receiving and reciprocating His love.
- Turning our eyes back to Christ and the cross dispels the attraction of worldly sin.

### The Epic Battle Sequence Within
Author: Laura MacCorkle
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-july-9-2010-11608632.html
Passage: 1 John 2:15-17
Points:
- Believers must intentionally guard what worldly media and ideas they permit into their hearts.
- Choosing what to consume creates an internal battle over where our allegiance truly lies.
- Christians should evaluate whether personal choices draw them closer to God or lead them astray.
- Experiencing internal friction against worldly culture is a healthy sign of spiritual sensitivity.
